query: News about Zohran Mamdani and surveillance technology
summary:
New York City Mayor Zohran Mamdani has publicly criticized the owner of Madison Square Garden, James Dolan, regarding the use of surveillance technology at the venue. Mamdani described such surveillance practices as reflective of broader societal issues, stating that they should not be permitted. He emphasized the importance of local legislation introduced by City Council member Shahana Hanif, which aims to ban the collection of biometric data, including facial recognition, in public spaces throughout the city. This legislative effort is seen as a necessary response to the growing concerns over surveillance practices [TechCrunch].

In a related discussion about technology and its implications, Mamdani has also addressed the broader topic of artificial intelligence (AI) and its impact on society. He has urged New Yorkers to resist the notion that AI's integration into daily life is inevitable, advocating for public accountability of AI companies. His administration has already taken steps to limit AI use in educational settings, specifically banning its application in elementary and middle schools [TechCrunch][Wired].

Mamdani's comments come at a time when there is a perceived lack of federal regulation on AI and surveillance technologies, prompting local leaders to take action. His stance reflects a growing concern among city officials regarding the implications of these technologies on privacy and civil liberties [Wired].

article_hits.title: Mamdani says feds have abdicated on AI, urges New Yorkers to push back
article_hits.content: Two of New York’s sweethearts, Mayor Zohran Mamdani and activist and “Broad City” star Ilana Glazer, spoke about AI at Webster Hall in Manhattan on Monday night, with Glazer posing questions to the mayor about the future of AI in society. Mamdani encouraged New Yorkers to resist the overwhelming feeling that AI is inevitably coming for their jobs, their kids’ minds, and their dignity, and to take back control instead. His message came at a moment when the federal government is doing little to regulate AI, leaving cities to act on their own. At The People’s AI Assembly, an event hosted by the AI Now Institute , a think tank that explores the social implications of AI, Mamdani argued that the technology’s rapid rollout is not inevitable and that public officials should hold AI companies accountable. article_hits.title: Mother of Ghanaian boy killed in US 'wants justice' as she flies for funeral
article_hits.content: Mother of Ghanaian boy killed in US 'wants justice' as she flies for funeral Image source, SantaClausians Image caption, Javits Frimpong was chased down and fatally shot last week on his way to school By Thomas Naadi BBC Africa , Reporting from Accra Published 4 November 2026, 14:01 GMT Updated 1 hour ago The mother of a 15-year-old Ghanaian boy who was fatally shot in the United States  last week has left Ghana for America after being granted an emergency visa by President Donald Trump. "I want justice for my son," Doris Adu Gyamfi told the BBC at the airport before her departure. She said he had dreamt of becoming a medical doctor. Her son, Javits Frimpong, who had only been in the US for a year, was chased down and shot on Thursday morning on his way to school in the Bronx, New York. He was taken to a local hospital, where he was pronounced dead. Police have not made any arrests and an investigation is ongoing as authorities search for three teenage boys in connection with the shoot
